# [TASK] Audit the 3 standalone housekeeping tasks

Audit the 3 standalone housekeeping tasks with `/audit-artifacts`: shape, voice, truth, proof.

Documentation tidy-up, Dependabot backlog triage, and a test-style cleanup. Each may belong under epic #76; if so, re-parent it and record that.

Scope: #173, #177, #234.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Task #173 audited: matches the task template, meets the writing standard, every claim checked against the code, every criterion names its proof, and its no-parent reason is real — re-parented under Story #77 (`docs/archive/README.md`'s claim rescoped: removed by `5b99e8a`, no longer exists)

## Notes
None of the three fit epic #76 directly (Tasks belong to Stories, not Epics). #173 and #177 match Story #77's own acceptance criteria almost verbatim (Dependabot bumps and doc/chore work referencing a Housekeeping Task) and are now its 18th and 19th sub-issues. #234 is a test-code convention change, outside #77's three specific criteria (dependency bumps, toolchain upgrades, dead-file/doc chores); no better-fitting Story exists, so it keeps its `## No parent` section with a tightened reason.

Story #316's other child, #317 (the 7 audit-tooling tasks), is still open — the next Task under that Story.
